audit.why: Sylas-favored early all-in (E dash 400 range, W heal), skill mid, Viktor-favored late — page prose and packet chart agree; full-layer sides lagged and are fixed in edits.
Spikes present and correct: Sylas 3-5 all-in, level 6 Hijack steal, Viktor 2+ item takeover.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer never named Sylas's abilities (packet defect) and used stale Viktor names 'Chaos Storm' and 'Death Ray' (kit: Arcane Storm, Hextech Ray). 'Hextech sustain' is not an ability — his heal is Kingslayer (W).
audit.why: Kit file is authority on names.
audit.corrected: Real names (Abscond/Abduct, Kingslayer, Hijack, Petricite Burst) folded into cooldowns, dos/donts and content edits; stale Viktor names replaced.

audit.why: Lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT; kit gives E 13s rank 1, W 12s, R 80/55/30.
needs-antiheal missing interaction already covered: report[8].t says add anti-heal early into his sustain.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Fire Hextech Ray from behind your casters — at 400 dash range he cannot Abduct onto you through the wave without eating it first.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: At half HP his Q-E-W combo with Petricite Burst autos kills you — back off, Q-shield up, and take the fragments later.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Gravity Field is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Abscond/Abduct (E): 13s at rank 1 — his only gap-closer; punish him hard while it is down, check it before every step-up. - Kingslayer (W) heal is on a 12s early cooldown. - Hijack is 80/55/30s and he may hold a stolen ult. Your 17s W is the lifeline.

edits.before: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast. Aim it through minions into his chest on every wave contact.
edits.after: E online evens it: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast, but his Q slow still starts trades if you stand loose.

edits.before: Chaos Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.
edits.after: Arcane Storm answers his all-in — but Hijack can steal it, so level 6 is a stand-off either side can win outright.

edits.before: Evolved late-game Viktor is a zone the enemy can't enter: W the choke, E the clump, and steer R through the retreat.
edits.after: Evolved Viktor out-ranges his chains: W the choke, E the clump, steer R through the retreat — he cannot reach you now.

edits.before: At level 6 your Chaos Storm answers his all-in and steal threat, keeping it even.
edits.after: At level 6 your Arcane Storm answers his all-in and steal threat, keeping it even.

edits.before: He can steal your Chaos Storm or another strong ult and all-in with full sustain, so hold your R for disengage and buy Zhonya's early to blank his combo dive.
edits.after: He can steal your Arcane Storm or another strong ult and all-in with full sustain, so hold your R for disengage and buy Zhonya's early to blank his combo dive.

edits.before: His hextech sustain and chain burst still out-trade you around first item; keep the wave in the middle, poke as he approaches, and don't get chained into the double E.
edits.after: His Kingslayer sustain and chain burst still out-trade you around first item; keep the wave in the middle, poke as he approaches, and don't get chained into the double E.

edits.before: Once you reach 2+ items your evolved Death Ray and Chaos Storm out-range his chains and let you kite his all-in; a fed Sylas is scary, but even-farmed your teamfight damage wins out.
edits.after: Once you reach 2+ items your evolved Hextech Ray and Arcane Storm out-range his chains and let you kite his all-in; a fed Sylas is scary, but even-farmed your teamfight damage wins out.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay in his favor around all-ins; his sustain and mobility beat your kit until you have items, so play safe, hold Chaos Storm to disengage, and rush Zhonya's to neutralize his dive.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay in his favor around all-ins; his sustain and mobility beat your kit until you have items, so play safe, hold Arcane Storm to disengage, and rush Zhonya's to neutralize his dive.

edits.before: At first item your poke offsets his hextech sustain, leaving the trade even.
edits.after: At first item your poke offsets his Kingslayer sustain, keeping the trade even.

edits.before: Steal a strong ult at 6 and burst you with full hextech sustain
edits.after: Steal a strong ult at 6 and burst you with Kingslayer sustain up

notes: Chart rule applied: content win[1/4/6] already matched the packet chart (Skill/Skill/Viktor); full sides moved alone with rating+why rewritten in the same group — no win[] no-ops. Level-6 rating set to 5/10 to match the 'Skill' verdict; the whys[4] content line already says even. Sylas R Hijack cooldown 80/55/30 is the ability's own CD; the stolen ult's usability window is not in the kit text so I did not state one.
